name: SecretRef

test_list.description: Configuration references convert to SDK secret locations and manually constructed invalid variants fail before provider access.
Environment and keyring identifiers obey the same fixed bounds at config and provider boundaries.
keyring:service/user parses into Keyring { service, user }.
env:NAME parses into Env(NAME); names are [A-Z0-9_]+.
A bare value (e.g. a token) is SecretLiteral.

output_description: References to secrets only; values never live in config.
